### What does this PR do?

Add three identity columns to both training rollout JSONL (from _log_rollout_data) and validation JSONL (from _validate) so offline analysis can:
  * group the n rollouts of each prompt by `uid`, and
  * left-join back to the source parquet by `(data_source, index)`.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: ...
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)
  - `{modules}` include `fsdp`, `megatron`, `veomni`, `sglang`, `vllm`, `rollout`, `trainer`, `ci`, `training_utils`, `recipe`, `hardware`, `deployment`, `ray`, `worker`, `single_controller`, `misc`, `perf`, `model`, `algo`, `env`, `tool`, `ckpt`, `doc`, `data`, `cfg`, `reward`, `fully_async`, `one_step_off`
  - If this PR involves multiple modules, separate them with `,` like `[megatron, fsdp, doc]`
  - `{type}` is in `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `chore`, `test`
  - If this PR breaks any API (CLI arguments, config, function signature, etc.), add `[BREAKING]` to the beginning of the title.
  - Example: `[BREAKING][fsdp, megatron] feat: dynamic batching`

### Test

- `tests/trainer/ppo/test_dump_join_keys_on_cpu.py`: 11 cases covering helper happy path, missing columns, empty batch, length mismatch, mixed input types (ndarray/list), native dtype preservation, uid stringification, collision warning, no-collision merge.
- `python -m pytest tests/trainer/ppo/test_dump_join_keys_on_cpu.py` passes (11 passed).
- `pre-commit run --files verl/trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py tests/trainer/ppo/test_dump_join_keys_on_cpu.py` passes (ruff, mypy, license, docstring, naming).

AI assistance (TRAE CLI) was used to draft the implementation plan and diff. Submitter reviewed every changed line.

### Design & Code Changes

- All three columns piggyback on `reward_extra_infos_dict` to avoid changing the `_dump_generations` signature.
- `uid` is canonicalized via `str()` (training/validation uids are already `str(uuid.uuid4())`); `data_source` and `index` keep native dtype so offline join does not need either side to pre-cast.
- Column collisions with reward-manager output warn + skip (keeping the reward value). Dump is an observability path; it must not be able to halt training.
- Length mismatch between join columns and `n` fails loud inside the `_build_join_keys` helper, bypassing the silent `len(v) == n` filter inside `_write_generations`.
- The validation dump branch uses a local copy of `reward_extra_infos_dict` so the join keys never reach `process_validation_metrics` or the `merged` return path.
- `rl_dataset.py:419` defaults `extra_info["index"]` to 0; datasets that fail to populate `extra_info["index"]` during preprocessing will have index=0 for every sample, which makes join-back infeasible. This is a dataset-provider responsibility and the dump path does not add defensive heuristics for it.

- [x] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs).
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code. If not feasible, explain why: ...
